# Space Coast Stories

> Space Coast Stories is a human-first personal history and legacy book studio based on Florida's Space Coast and serving families in all 50 states by phone and video. Claire Szewczyk personally interviews, writes, and edits life stories, photographs, letters, and memories into printed family keepsakes. Services start at $149 with One Story; there is no subscription and no AI memoir writing.

## Key pages
- /one-story/ - one personal prompt, one phone call, human editing, and one printed keepsake for $149
- /shop/ - all DIY, physical, gift, and human-written options sorted by price
- /nationwide/ - how phone and video projects work in all 50 states
- /tools/ - free question generator, legacy book cost calculator, eulogy outline builder, quiz, and printables
- /diy/ - printable prompts, interview templates, eulogy tools, and other self-guided products
- /gift/ - printable gift certificates usable nationwide
- /rapid-fire/ - 45-minute remote interview, digital booklet, and one printed copy for $249
- /legacy-books/ - custom legacy books
- /family-history-book-service/ - family history book writing, design, and print preparation
- /life-story-books-for-parents-grandparents/ - custom life story books for families nationwide
- /dementia-life-story-books/ - gently adapted life story books for people living with dementia
- /memorial-tribute-books/ - custom memorial and tribute books
- /space-coast-history/ - Brevard County and Space Coast oral history hub

- /portfolio/ - sample covers and interior pages
- /brevard-county/ - local service areas
- /storytelling-workshops/ - workshops for libraries and senior communities
- /blog/ - practical family history and oral history guides
- /contact/ - start a project

## Expertise
Personal history interviews, oral history, family memoirs, legacy books, memorial and tribute books, veteran stories, NASA and Space Coast oral history, legacy letters, family photograph organization, and storytelling workshops.
